correctness.rationale: The 9! labelled permutations were exhaustively filtered into 133496 derangements, legal swaps examined at all 36 pairs of positions, and shortest-path BFS recomputed for eight representatives of all conjugacy classes. Independently written C++ produced graph degree sum 3671136, all eight eccentricities (9,8,9,8,10,9,8,8), and one inverse antipode at distance ten in the (3,3,3) class, no others. Conjugation equivariance proves class exhaustiveness; 2240 such derangements yield 1120 unordered inverse pairs. The BFS certifies only n=9, not an unbounded diameter theorem.
residual_risks: Finite exact graph proof requires exhaustive BFS code, a complete cycle-type orbit argument and correct legal-move predicate; no implication for n>9.
